Primary request: Create premium original key art for Mio Amamiya from “Signal at Blue Hour.”

Subject: Mio Amamiya is explicitly a 23-year-old adult Japanese woman and graduate astronomy researcher working the night shift at a seaside radio observatory. She has a clearly adult face and body proportions, a graceful oval face, clear teal-gray eyes, and dark-indigo shoulder-length bobbed hair with a soft inward curl and side-swept fringe. A small gold four-point star hairpin is her signature accessory. Her expression is reserved but kind: attentive eyes and a faint confident half-smile.

Wardrobe: contemporary adult professional research attire, not a school uniform—a softly tailored navy knit research cardigan with subtle amber-gold buttons over an ivory mock-neck blouse, plus a slim amber pendant necklace. Practical, tasteful, modest, and refined.
Scene/backdrop: painterly blue-hour seaside radio-observatory terrace, distant dish silhouettes and ocean glow, atmospheric and secondary to the character.

Style/medium: polished contemporary Japanese visual-novel anime illustration; original character design; clean expressive linework, soft cel shading, delicate hair highlights, controlled material detail, premium dating-sim key-art finish.

Composition/framing: portrait-oriented 2:3 canvas; single character, half-body from the top of the hair through the natural waist; three-quarter torso angle with face and gaze toward viewer; relaxed upright posture; generous headroom; fully visible hair, shoulders, cardigan front, pendant, and waist; no dramatic foreshortening.
Lighting/mood: cool indigo/teal blue-hour rim light balanced by restrained warm amber observatory light; quiet intimacy and trust; tasteful 15+ slow-burn romance.

Identity invariants: exactly one adult woman; dark-indigo shoulder-length bob; teal-gray eyes; small gold four-point star hairpin; navy cardigan; ivory mock-neck blouse; amber pendant; clearly age 23; preserve these exact details for downstream expression variants.

Constraints: no text, title, logo, signature, border, UI, speech bubble, or watermark; no other people; no suggestive pose, cleavage emphasis, fetish styling, or sexualization; no school uniform, sailor collar, school badge, backpack, classroom, childlike proportions, or minor coding.
Avoid: photorealism; 3D-render look; chibi proportions; giant head; exaggerated anatomy; costume clutter; pseudo-text.
